gloss: to associate with, to date, to keep company

definitions.explanation: To have a relationship or dealings with someone.

definitions.gloss: to date, to go out with
definitions.explanation: To be in a romantic relationship.

examples.japanese: {彼女|かのじょ}と{付|つ}き{合|あ}っている。
{買|か}い{物|もの}に{付|つ}き{合|あ}う。
{近所|きんじょ}の{人|ひと}と{上手|うま}く{付|つ}き{合|あ}う。
examples.english: To get along well with neighbors.

notes:
{付|つ}き{合|あ}う covers various types of relationships.

COMMON USES:
- {恋人|こいびと}と{付|つ}き{合|あ}う: to date someone
- ～に{付|つ}き{合|あ}う: to accompany someone to ~
- {長|なが}い{付|つ}き{合|あ}い: a long relationship
